verdict.rationale: Disk encryption backed by a TPM is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions disk encryption, LUKS, TPM enrollment or hardware-backed key storage. The only privacy material is a general claim that 'your data belongs to you', which is unrelated to disk encryption.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can encrypt my disk using TPM-backed hardware encryption
